5. stream-scanner (streams, connections, file handles, child process leaks)

Collect ALL findings from each agent and compile a comprehensive report.

For each finding, include:
- File path and line number
- Category (timer, listener, cache, global state, stream/file/process)
- The leaking code pattern
- Whether cleanup exists
- A concrete fix suggestion

Once you have all results, write the consolidated report to /tmp/ruflo-memory-leak-report.md so I can present it.
